intro.title: More Than a Logo: A Complete Brand Identity
paragraphs: Your brand identity is everything people see, read and feel when they come across your business: your logo, colours, fonts, imagery, tone of voice and the way they all work together. A strong, consistent identity makes a small business look established, helps a startup stand out in a crowded market and makes every marketing rupee work harder.

Our brand identity design services start with strategy, not software. We learn about your business, audience and competitors, define what makes you different, then design a visual identity system that expresses it: logo and logo variations, colour palette, typography, graphic elements and a clear brand style guide so your team, printers and agencies apply it correctly.

From logo design and corporate identity to packaging, stationery, social media kits and your website, we keep everything consistent. Once your identity is ready, we can bring it online with a <customweb>custom website design</customweb>, or you can <contact>tell us about your brand</contact> for a free consultation.

faqs.title: Brand Identity Design FAQs
faqs.subtitle: Quick answers about branding and identity design.

items.q: Is brand identity design important for startups?
items.a: Yes. A clear brand identity helps startups look credible to customers and investors, stand out from competitors and stay consistent as the team grows. It is much easier to start consistent than to fix a messy brand later.

items.q: What does a brand identity package include?
items.a: A typical brand identity package includes a logo and its variations, colour palette, typography, graphic elements and a brand style guide. Larger packages add stationery, social media kits, packaging, templates and tone of voice.

items.q: How much does brand identity design cost?
items.a: A mini brand identity typically costs $300 to $800, a complete brand identity $800 to $2,500, and a corporate identity system from $2,500, depending on the deliverables you need.

items.q: How do you do branding for a company?
items.a: We start with a consultation and research into your business, audience and competitors, agree a creative brief, design and refine logo and identity concepts, then deliver a brand style guide and all files, and help roll the brand out.

items.q: What is the difference between a logo, brand identity and branding?
items.a: A logo is a single mark. Brand identity is the full visual and verbal system around it: colours, fonts, imagery and voice. Branding is the ongoing process of shaping how people perceive your business using that identity.

items.q: How long does brand identity design take?
items.a: A mini identity usually takes 1 to 2 weeks, a complete brand identity 2 to 4 weeks, and a corporate identity system 4 weeks or more, depending on feedback rounds.
